item.title: Version 2.4.0
item.description:
A quick note. It’s been quiet here for a few weeks, for reasons outside my control — sorry about that. I’m still very much building ADSwift. Almost everything below came from someone writing in about something that was broken or missing, so please keep sending those. — Saad

Added

  • Add negative keywords while you create a campaign. The create form now takes a pasted or typed list of negative keywords with a match type, and applies it to each campaign as it’s made. Previously they could only be added once the campaign already existed.

Improved

  • Daily budgets are editable without selecting anything first. A “Daily Budgets” button now sits in the toolbar next to the ad group table’s Adjust Bids, and appears in the right-click menu and the Adjust menu. With nothing selected it edits every campaign in view; select two or more and it narrows to those.

Fixed

  • Duplicating a campaign that has already run works again. Any copy of a live campaign was rejected outright for having a start date in the past. Copies now start from today, and run open-ended when the original’s schedule has already closed.
  • A brief connection problem no longer marks an account with a permanent sync error. A rate limit or a temporary outage was recorded as though your credentials had been refused, and nothing could clear it afterwards. Only an actual refusal counts now, a successful refresh clears the warning on its own, and the account shows what was reported back.
  • The custom product page you pick is the one you see. Choosing a custom product page in the New Ad or New Ad Group form left the screenshots below it showing the app’s default listing, so a second page looked like it had never loaded.
